title: Health check returns ok
objective: Verify GET /health returns 200 without authentication
expected_result: 200; body equals {"status": "ok"}

title: Create with required fields applies defaults
objective: Verify a minimal valid payload creates a customer with documented defaults
steps: 1. POST /customers with name and email only | 2. GET the Location URL
expected_result: 201; Customer schema valid; name trimmed to 'Ada Lovelace'; status=active; credit_limit=0; Location=/customers/{id}; GET returns the same body

title: Accepts credit_limit boundaries inside range
objective: Verify credit_limit 0, 1, 49999 and 50000 are accepted
expected_result: 201 for each value; response echoes the credit_limit and status

title: Rejects credit_limit outside range
objective: Verify credit_limit -1 and 50001 are rejected
expected_result: 422 validation_error; details include field credit_limit; no customer created

title: Rejects non-integer credit_limit
objective: Verify string, decimal, boolean and null credit_limit values are rejected
expected_result: 422 validation_error naming credit_limit

title: Rejects missing required fields
objective: Verify each required field missing (one at a time) is reported
test_data: payload without name; payload without email
steps: 1. POST /customers without name | 2. POST /customers without email
expected_result: 422 validation_error; details name the missing field

title: Validates name length and blankness
objective: Verify name length boundaries 1..100 and blank rejection
expected_result: 100 chars -> 201; empty, whitespace-only, 101 chars and number -> 422 naming name

title: Rejects invalid email formats
objective: Verify malformed or non-string emails are rejected
expected_result: 422 validation_error naming email

title: Rejects disallowed status on create
objective: Verify a customer cannot be created as closed or with unknown/miscased status
expected_result: 422 validation_error naming status

title: Rejects unknown and privilege-like fields
objective: Verify additionalProperties false rejects id, role and is_admin
expected_result: 422 validation_error naming the unknown field; no customer created

title: Rejects malformed JSON
objective: Verify malformed, empty and non-object JSON bodies return 400
steps: 1. POST /customers with Content-Type application/json and each raw body
expected_result: 400 malformed_json; Error schema valid

title: Rejects unsupported media type
objective: Verify non-JSON Content-Type returns 415
expected_result: 415 unsupported_media_type

title: Rejects duplicate email ignoring case
objective: Verify email uniqueness is case-insensitive on create
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
test_data: same email as existing customer in upper case
steps: 1. Create customer A | 2. POST /customers with A's email upper-cased
expected_result: 409 email_conflict; Error schema valid; only one customer with that email

title: Idempotent retry replays original response
objective: Verify the same Idempotency-Key and body does not create a duplicate
test_data: Idempotency-Key unique per run; identical body
steps: 1. POST /customers with Idempotency-Key K | 2. Repeat the identical request
expected_result: Both 201 with the same id; second has Idempotent-Replayed: true; first does not; list contains the email once

title: Rejects Idempotency-Key reuse with different body
objective: Verify reusing a key with a different body is rejected
steps: 1. POST with key K and body A | 2. POST with key K and body B
expected_result: First 201; second 422 idempotency_key_reused; body B not created

title: Rejects requests without token
objective: Verify every protected operation requires a bearer token
steps: 1. Call GET/POST /customers and GET/PATCH/DELETE /customers/{id} without Authorization
expected_result: 401 unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer for every operation; Error schema valid

title: Rejects invalid or malformed tokens
objective: Verify invalid tokens and wrong schemes are rejected
test_data: Authorization in {Bearer not-a-real-token, Basic ..., Bearer, token without scheme}
expected_result: 401 unauthorized

title: Rejects expired token
objective: Verify an expired token returns token_expired
preconditions: Expired token available in the target environment
expected_result: 401 token_expired

title: Get existing customer
objective: Verify GET returns the stored customer
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
expected_result: 200; Customer schema valid; body equals created customer

title: Get unknown customer returns 404
objective: Verify unknown and malformed ids return not_found
expected_result: 404 not_found; Error schema valid

title: List is paginated and ordered by id
objective: Verify pagination metadata and ordering
preconditions: Valid user token; at least 3 customers exist
expected_result: 200 CustomerList; 2 items ordered by id; pagination echoes limit/offset; total>=3; offset=total returns empty data

title: List filters by status
objective: Verify the status filter returns only matching customers
preconditions: Valid user token; one active and one suspended customer
expected_result: 200; every item has status suspended; the suspended customer is included

title: Validates pagination and filter parameters
objective: Verify limit boundaries 1..100, offset>=0 and status enum
expected_result: limit 1 and 100 -> 200; limit 0, 101, abc, offset -1, status deleted -> 422 naming the parameter

title: Partial update changes only given fields
objective: Verify PATCH applies a partial update
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
expected_result: 200; Customer schema valid; name updated; email, status, credit_limit and created_at unchanged

title: Valid status transitions succeed
objective: Verify every allowed lifecycle transition
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
expected_result: 200 at every step; status reflects the target state

title: Closed customer cannot be modified
objective: Verify closed is terminal
preconditions: Valid user token; customer in status closed
steps: 1. Close customer | 2. PATCH with each payload | 3. GET customer
expected_result: 409 invalid_state_transition for each; Error schema valid; status remains closed

title: Rejects empty update body
objective: Verify minProperties 1 on PATCH
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
expected_result: 422 validation_error

title: Email uniqueness on update
objective: Verify changing email to another customer's email conflicts and re-casing own email does not
preconditions: Valid user token; customers A and B exist
steps: 1. PATCH B with A's email upper-cased | 2. PATCH A with its own email upper-cased
expected_result: Step 1: 409 email_conflict; step 2: 200

title: Update unknown customer returns 404
objective: Verify PATCH on unknown id
expected_result: 404 not_found

title: Admin deletes customer
objective: Verify admin deletion and its side effect
expected_result: 204 with empty body; subsequent GET returns 404

title: Non-admin cannot delete
objective: Verify user role is forbidden to delete
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
expected_result: 403 forbidden; Error schema valid; customer still exists (200)

title: Delete unknown customer returns 404
objective: Verify DELETE on unknown id
expected_result: 404 not_found

title: Concurrent creates with the same email
objective: Verify uniqueness holds under concurrent requests
test_data: 8 parallel POSTs with one unique email
steps: 1. Send 8 POST /customers in parallel with the same email
expected_result: Exactly one 201 and seven 409 email_conflict

title: Rejects credit_limit out of range on update
objective: Verify BR-3 is enforced on PATCH
preconditions: Valid user token; customer with credit_limit 100
steps: 1. PATCH credit_limit with each value | 2. GET customer
expected_result: 422 validation_error; credit_limit remains 100

title: PATCH rejects malformed JSON and wrong media type
objective: Verify 400 and 415 on PATCH
preconditions: Valid user token; customer created via POST /customers
steps: 1. PATCH with malformed JSON | 2. PATCH with text/plain
expected_result: Step 1: 400 malformed_json; step 2: 415 unsupported_media_type
